outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command: ls -la /app/ && which qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-x86 ssh sshpass expect 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -la /app/alpine.iso 2>&1
cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---kvm---"; ls -la /dev/kvm 2>&1; echo "---cpu---"; nproc; free -h
qemu-img info /app/alpine-disk.qcow2; echo "---"; qemu-img info /app/alpine.iso | head -20; echo "---tools---"; which qemu-nbd guestfish virt-customize 7z bsdtar xorriso isoinfo 2>&1
ls /usr/share/qemu/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---bios---"; ls /usr/share/seabios/ /usr/share/ovmf/ /usr/share/qemu/*bios* 2>&1; echo "---ip---"; ip addr 2>/dev/null | head -30

python3 -c "import pexpect; print('pexpect', pexpect.__version__)" 2>&1; which python3 socat tmux screen nc 2>&1; echo "---net---"; getent hosts dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org 2>&1; timeout 5 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/8.8.8.8/53 && echo net-ok' 2>&1

timeout 90 qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -smp 2 -cdrom alpine.iso -boot d -nographic -no-reboot -netdev user,id=n0 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0 </dev/null > /tmp/boottest.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c /tmp/boottest.log; tail -c 3000 /tmp/boottest.log

tmux kill-session -t vm 2>/dev/null; tmux new-session -d -s vm -x 200 -y 50 "qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -smp 2 -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -drive file=/app/alpine-disk.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0 -nographic -monitor none 2>&1 | tee /tmp/vm.log"; sleep 45; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p | tail -20
tmux ls 2>&1; echo "---log---"; cat /tmp/vm.log 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "---ps---"; ps aux | grep -c qemu
sleep 20; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p -S -200 | tail -25; echo "===log==="; tail -c 500 /tmp/vm.log
tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 25; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p -S -300 | tail -30

tmux capture-pane -t vm -p > /tmp/cap.txt 2>/tmp/caperr.txt; echo "rc=$?"; wc -c /tmp/cap.txt /tmp/caperr.txt; cat /tmp/caperr.txt; echo "---procs---"; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *qemu*) echo "$p: $c";; esac; done; echo "---log size---"; wc -c /tmp/vm.log

tmux kill-session -t vm 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -f /tmp/pane.raw /tmp/vm.log; tmux new-session -d -s vm -x 200 -y 50 "qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -smp 2 -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -drive file=/app/alpine-disk.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0 -nographic -monitor none"; tmux pipe-pane -t vm -o 'cat >> /tmp/pane.raw'; sleep 3; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 40; echo "---capture---"; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p -S -100 | tail -15; echo "---raw tail---"; tail -c 800 /tmp/pane.raw
tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 45; echo "---raw tail---"; tail -c 1500 /tmp/pane.raw; echo; echo "---matches---"; grep -a -o "localhost login:" /tmp/pane.raw | tail -2

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "root"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 3; tmux send-keys -t vm -l "export PS1='PROMPT# '; echo LOGIN_OK; cat /etc/alpine-release; which sshd; ls /etc/ssh 2>&1; apk info -e openssh 2>&1; ifconfig -a 2>&1 | head -20"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 8; tail -c 3000 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "mount | grep -i -E 'cdrom|sr0'; echo ---; ls /media/cdrom 2>&1; echo ---; ls /media/cdrom/apks 2>&1 | head; echo ---; udhcpc -i eth0 -q -n 2>&1; ip -4 addr show eth0 2>&1; echo ---; wget -q -T 15 -O /dev/null http://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.19/main/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz && echo NET_OK || echo NET_FAIL"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 25; tail -c 2500 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm C-c; sleep 2; tmux send-keys -t vm -l "ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64 | grep -E 'openssh|dropbear|sshd' ; echo ---COUNT---; ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64 | wc -l; echo ---ALL---; ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64 | head -40"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; sleep 5; tail -c 1800 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux kill-server 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /tmp/pane.raw; tmux new-session -d -s vm -x 200 -y 50 "stty raw -echo; exec qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -smp 2 -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -drive file=/app/alpine-disk.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2 -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0 -nographic -monitor none"; tmux pipe-pane -t vm -o 'cat >> /tmp/pane.raw'; for i in $(seq 1 40); do grep -aq "boot:" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; sleep 1; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 90); do grep -aq "localhost login:" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; echo "=== state ==="; tail -c 400 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "root"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 15); do grep -aq "localhost:~#" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tmux send-keys -t vm -l "export PS1='P# '; ip link set eth0 up; udhcpc -i eth0 -q -n -t 5; ip -4 addr show eth0; echo ---PKGS---; ls /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64 | grep -iE '^openssh|^dropbear|^libcrypto|^libssl|^ncurses|^zlib'; echo ---IDX---; ls -la /media/cdrom/apks/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz; echo DONE_MARK"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 40); do grep -aq "DONE_MARK" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tail -c 1600 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "echo /media/cdrom/apks > /etc/apk/repositories; apk update 2>&1 | tail -3; echo ---ADD---; apk add openssh 2>&1 | tail -15; echo ADD_RC=\$?; echo ---WHICH---; which sshd ssh-keygen chpasswd; echo INSTALL_DONE"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 60); do grep -aq "INSTALL_DONE" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tail -c 1800 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "ssh-keygen -A 2>&1 | tail -2; echo 'root:password123' | chpasswd && echo PASSWD_SET; grep -nE '^[# ]*(PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication)' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; echo CFG_SHOWN"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 20); do grep -aq "CFG_SHOWN" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tail -c 1400 /tmp/pane.raw
for i in $(seq 1 60); do grep -aq "CFG_SHOWN" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 2; done; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p | tail -20; echo "=== raw tail ==="; tail -c 700 /tmp/pane.raw

tmux send-keys -t vm -l "echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config; echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config; mkdir -p /run/sshd; rc-service sshd start 2>&1; sleep 1; netstat -lnt 2>&1 | grep -E ':22|LISTEN'; echo SSHD_STARTED"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 30); do grep -aq "SSHD_STARTED" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; echo "=== console ==="; tail -c 900 /tmp/pane.raw; echo "=== host port check ==="; (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/2222) 2>&1 && echo PORT_OPEN || echo PORT_CLOSED

sleep 3; echo "=== banner grab ==="; timeout 8 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/2222; head -c 60 <&3' 2>&1 | cat -v; echo; echo "=== console now ==="; tmux capture-pane -t vm -p | tail -12; echo "=== sshd proc in guest? ==="; tmux send-keys -t vm -l "pgrep -a sshd; netstat -lnt | grep :22; echo CHECK_DONE"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 20); do grep -aq "CHECK_DONE" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tail -c 500 /tmp/pane.raw

echo "=== nc banner ==="; timeout 8 nc 127.0.0.1 2222 | head -c 120 | cat -v; echo; echo "rc=$?"; echo "=== qemu hostfwd ==="; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 2222 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 2222

echo "=== host ssh verbose (batch) ==="; timeout 15 ssh -vv -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=8 -p 2222 root@127.0.0.1 true 2>&1 | tail -25; echo; echo "=== guest local banner test ==="; tmux send-keys -t vm -l "nc 10.0.2.15 22 | head -c 50; echo; echo NCLOCAL_DONE"; tmux send-keys -t vm Enter; for i in $(seq 1 15); do grep -aq "NCLOCAL_DONE" /tmp/pane.raw && break; sleep 1; done; tail -c 400 /tmp/pane.raw

echo "=== qemu processes ==="; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *qemu-system*) echo "PID ${p#/proc/}: $c";; esac; done
echo "=== pane pid ==="; tmux list-panes -t vm -F 'pane_pid=#{pane_pid} pane_dead=#{pane_dead}'
echo "=== port 2222 owners (tcp) ==="; awk '$2 ~ /:08AE$/ {print "local="$2" inode="$10}' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null
echo "=== socket inodes of qemu procs ==="; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *qemu-system*) echo "PID ${p#/proc/} fds:"; ls -l $p/fd 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'socket:\[[0-9]*\]' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo;; esac; done
echo; echo "=== guest state ==="; tail -c 300 /tmp/pane.raw
